methodology.UserFees: All swap, outbound and affiliate fees paid by users when swapping through THORChain (slashing is paid by nodes, not users).
methodology.Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools, gross outbound fees and slashing fees paid into the Reserve, and affiliate fees charged by interfaces/wallets (affiliate fees are attributed to the THORChain native chain). RUNE block-reward emissions and the native tx fee (counted in the THORChain chain fees adapter) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Income kept by the protocol: outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees paid into the Reserve, plus the 5% developer fund, 5% marketing fund and 20% protocol-owned liquidity taken from swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to RUNE holders: the share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before), permanently removed from supply - the only component that accrues to every RUNE holder.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value paid to suppliers: the node-operator (RUNE bonder) share of swap fees set by the Incentive Pendulum (a security cost), the liquidity-provider share of swap fees (LP side of the Incentive Pendulum), affiliate fees passed through to integrators, the 10% of swap fees paid to TCY stakers, and the outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to nodes.

Fees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
Fees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

UserFees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
UserFees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
UserFees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

Revenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).
Revenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
Revenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
Revenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

ProtocolRevenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
ProtocolRevenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

HoldersRevenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply and accruing value to RUNE holders (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To RUNE Bonders: Node operators' (RUNE bonders') share of swap fees, set network-wide by the Incentive Pendulum - a security cost paid to the nodes that bond RUNE to secure the network.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Liquidity providers' share of swap fees (the LP side of the Incentive Pendulum).
SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate Fees To Integrators: Affiliate fees passed through to the integrator that built the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.TCY Staker Rewards: 10% of swap fees paid in RUNE to TCY stakers (since 2025-05-01).
SupplySideRevenue.Gas Reimbursement: Outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to the nodes that broadcast outbound transactions, paid out of the gross outbound fee.

methodology.Volume: Volume is calculated from Swap events on TrueMarkets prediction market pools, enumerated from the active markets on TruthMarketManager. V1 markets use Uniswap V3 pools (USDC pairs), V2 markets use Uniswap V4 pools (TYD pairs). Only the stablecoin side of swaps is counted, with TYD (a yield-bearing USDC vault share) converted to USDC at its share price; pools quoted in the outcome token of another market are skipped.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders: the TrueMarkets hook fee on Uniswap V4 market pools (0.2% on the original markets, 0.8% on Launchpad markets) and the Uniswap LP fee on market pools (0.8% on the original V4 markets, the pool fee tier on V3 markets), plus Launchpad fees charged on proposal graduation and Live-phase withdrawals. Fees taken in outcome tokens are valued at the price of the swap that paid them.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees that go to the protocol rather than to market creators or liquidity providers, plus all Launchpad fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap fees that go to the protocol treasury rather than to market creators or liquidity providers, plus all Launchpad fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees paid out to market creators (100% of the hook fee on Launchpad markets and 50% on two of the original markets) and Uniswap LP fees earned by market liquidity providers.

Fees.Trading Fees: Swap fees charged by the hook on V4 market pools, from PoolFeeTracked events on each hook's FeeCollector. Fees taken in outcome tokens (exact-input buys) are valued in TYD at the execution price of the swap that paid them.
Fees.LP Fees: Uniswap LP fees on market pools: the Swap event fee on V4 pools (0.8% on the original markets, 1 pip on Launchpad markets) and the pool fee tier on V3 pools, applied to the stablecoin side of each swap.
Fees.Launchpad Fees: Launchpad protocol fees (charged on proposal graduation and Live-phase withdrawals) are tracked via TYD transfers from the Launchpad to the fee receiver.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Share of swap fees paid to the FeeCollector's default (protocol) recipient: everything not assigned to a market creator.
Revenue.Launchpad Fees: Launchpad protocol fees (charged on proposal graduation and Live-phase withdrawals) are tracked via TYD transfers from the Launchpad to the fee receiver.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Share of swap fees paid to the FeeCollector's default (protocol) recipient: everything not assigned to a market creator.
ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad Fees: Launchpad protocol fees (charged on proposal graduation and Live-phase withdrawals) are tracked via TYD transfers from the Launchpad to the fee receiver.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: Share of swap fees assigned to the market creator in the pool's FeeCollector recipient config (100% on Launchpad markets).
SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees To Liquidity Providers: Uniswap LP fees earned by the liquidity providers of market pools.

methodology.Fees: 6% on every BidRouter swap-back and marketplace sale, plus (until 2026-07-23) 5% of each claw pull taken by V1/V2 machines at play time. ClawMachineV3 no longer takes a pull-time cut: the full play price goes to the claw finance wallet and Beezie's take is realized as the 6% fee when cards are swapped back through the BidRouter - the same model as Solana, where the claw take is the 6% swap fee alone and the marketplace's 6% is paid out by the Metaplex Core royalties plugin. Trade volume itself is not counted - only Beezie's cut.
methodology.Revenue: Beezie keeps 100% of all fees - no share goes to sellers, creators, or LPs.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All revenue goes to the Beezie treasury.

Fees.Claw Machine Fees: 5% of play price per pull (V1: on-chain commission field; V2: Played.amount x 5%) - the non-refundable cut after a SWAP-back. Ended 2026-07-23 when ClawMachineV3 moved the cut to swap-back time; not charged on Solana either, where the claw likewise takes its cut on the swap
Fees.Swap Fees: 6% of the buyback value when a user swaps a won item back - through BidRouter on Base (funded by the claw finance wallet since V3), or kept in the claw's centralized pool on Solana and read from the BuybackExecuted event
Fees.Marketplace Fees: 6% on every P2P collectible sale through BidRouter; on Solana, the same 6% paid by the Core royalties plugin, split across Beezie's platform-fee and creator wallets

methodology.Fees: Daily change in protocol net surplus (total collateral value minus USDp outstanding), in two lines: the mint, burn and redeem fees paid that day, computed from the Parallelizer's Swap and Redeemed events at the rates the contract applies (read on-chain), and the yield from the yield-bearing collateral, which is the rest of the surplus change.
methodology.Revenue: DAO Treasury share of net surplus accrual, on both lines: 9% before June 1, 2026, and 10% thereafter (the 1% previously paid to Angle Labs is redistributed to the DAO after the BUSL 1.1 license expires).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DAO Treasury share of net surplus accrual, on both lines: 9% before June 1, 2026, 10% after (Angle Labs 1% redistributed to DAO post license expiry).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 90% of net surplus accrual distributed to sUSDp savings holders, plus, before June 1, 2026, the 1% license share paid to Angle Labs under BUSL 1.1 (PIP-50), on both lines.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: None: the surplus share kept by the protocol goes to the DAO Treasury. The Treasury's PRL buybacks are not counted here. Those funded by the PRL holders' share of Parallel V2 fees under PGP-42 are counted at that fee source, in Parallel V2's holders revenue; the others are paid from the Treasury's holdings (the PGP-40 monthly allocation, the PGP-45 OTC buyback).

Fees.Yield From Backing Collateral: Surplus change minus the mint, burn and redeem fees: yield accrued on the yield-bearing collateral held by the Parallelizer.
Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Fees kept in the Parallelizer's reserves on mints, burns and redemptions. Per Swap event, the USDp minted times the asset's mint fee, or the USDp burnt times its burn fee, at the asset's rate inside its exposure band (getCollateralMintFees, getCollateralBurnFees). Per Redeemed event, the USDp redeemed times min(collateral ratio, 1) times one minus the redemption curve factor (getRedemptionFees).

Revenue.Yield to DAO Treasury: 9% of net surplus accrual before June 1, 2026; 10% after (the 1% previously paid to Angle Labs is redistributed to the DAO Treasury post license expiry).
Revenue.Mint/Redeem Fees to DAO Treasury: 9% of the mint, burn and redeem fees before June 1, 2026; 10% after.

ProtocolRevenue.Yield to DAO Treasury: 9% of net surplus accrual before June 1, 2026; 10% after (the 1% previously paid to Angle Labs is redistributed to the DAO Treasury post license expiry).
ProtocolRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees to DAO Treasury: 9% of the mint, burn and redeem fees before June 1, 2026; 10% after.

SupplySideRevenue.Yield to sUSDp Savings Holders: 90% of net surplus accrual distributed to sUSDp stakers as savings yield.
SupplySideRevenue.Yield to Angle Labs: 1% of net surplus accrual paid to Angle Labs under BUSL 1.1 license (PIP-50), applicable only before June 1, 2026.
SupplySideRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees to sUSDp Savings Holder: 90% of the mint, burn and redeem fees, distributed to sUSDp stakers as savings yield.
SupplySideRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees to Angle Labs: 1% of the mint, burn and redeem fees paid to Angle Labs under BUSL 1.1 license (PIP-50), applicable only before June 1, 2026.

methodology.Fees: The fee taken when a user moves funds out of a shielded pool - a withdrawal, a swap or a bridge transfer - read as the exact amount the pool paid Privacy Cash rather than a modelled rate. The published schedule is 0.35% of the amount, plus a flat charge that covers relaying the transaction: 0.006 SOL on Solana (0.008 SOL for swaps), 0.00025 ETH on Base, and a variable network-based charge on Ethereum. Deposits are free. Jupiter swap fees and the 0.1% NEAR bridging fee are paid to those protocols, not to Privacy Cash, and are not counted here.

methodology.Revenue: All of it. Privacy Cash has no liquidity providers, lenders or stakers to pay, so nothing is deducted from fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of it. Every fee is paid to a Privacy Cash treasury wallet; the relayers that submit withdrawals receive none of it and only cover gas.

When a maker's own strategies trade against each other within one transaction, the LP fee is paid back to the same wallet and only counts on the maker's net change; the DAO share is always counted. Fills of positions on the legacy developer-release registry (pre-2026-07-19, a handful of test positions on an earlier instruction set) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All DAO revenue accrues to the 1inch DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of each fill's swap fee retained by the LP inside the maker-owned wallet (Aqua is non-custodial): total fee minus the DAO share. Fees a maker's own strategies pay each other within one transaction are excluded.

Fees.Aqua LP Swap Fees: Swap-fee share retained by LPs in their own wallets, priced per fill from the decoded position fee rate.
Fees.1inch DAO Fee Share: Swap-fee share transferred to the 1inch DAO fee exchanger at fill time, priced per fill from the decoded protocol-fee rate.

SupplySideRevenue.Aqua LP Swap Fees: LP-retained swap fees (total fee minus the DAO share).

Revenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: The DAO's decoded per-fill fee share (validated against fee-exchanger inflows).

ProtocolRevenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: DAO fee share accruing to the 1inch DAO treasury.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All API fees accrue to MiroShark.

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers: for every trade, the face value of the debt (units) minus the loan tokens the borrower received (sellerAssets), i.e. the fixed-rate discount locked in at execution.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue: settlement fee plus continuous fee. Currently 0 while both fees are disabled.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest distributed to lenders: total borrow interest minus the protocol settlement and continuous fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Settlement fee plus continuous fee per trade. Currently 0.

Revenue.LaunchLab Platform Fees: Solana — LaunchLab platform fees received by Squeeze claim wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Doppler Protocol Fees: Estimated Doppler Airlock protocol-owner share of EVM pool fees (5% of gross).

Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap and launch fees retained by the protocol treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Actual swap credits allocated to creators and referrers, including amounts still unclaimed.

methodology.Volume: Sum of the input amount of every executed order, taken from the router's OrderExecuted logs. Only the input leg is counted, so a single trade is never counted twice. Cancellations, which the previous router encoded as an OrderExecuted with orderType 255, are excluded.
methodology.Fees: Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order and capped on-chain at 1%.
methodology.Revenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.

methodology.Fees: Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).
methodology.Revenue: Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue kept by the AGNT treasury: everything in Revenue except the burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of each AGNTS activation's $AGNTS cost that is burned (burnBps, 50% today).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 68% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators (63%) and the Doppler protocol (~5%), estimated from the observed platform WETH share.

Fees.Launchpad Fees: 1.095% Doppler terminal fee (WETH leg), estimated as platform WETH share / 0.32, on Base + Robinhood Chain.
Fees.Trading Fees: 0.40% swap fee (Base), WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient wallet.
Fees.Pons Launchpad Fees: PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood Chain (native-ETH leg), the `total` of each token's AgntFeeWedge Split event.
Fees.NFT Mint Fees: Native ETH paid by buyers minting AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain, measured as proceeds withdrawn from the mint controller.
Fees.Activation Fees: ETH fee paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.Activation $AGNTS: $AGNTS paid to activate an AGNTS NFT (Robinhood), from the Activated event.
Fees.NFT Swap Fees: ETH fee for AGNTS NFT swaps (random packs and exact picks) on Robinhood, read from the swap engine at each swap's block.

Revenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
Revenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
Revenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
Revenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS to Protocol: The non-burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost, sent to the treasury (Robinhood).
Revenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees to Protocol: 100% of the 0.40% swap fee, WETH + USDC paid by Relay to the app-fee recipient (Base)
ProtocolRevenue.Pons Fees to Protocol: AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) cut of PonsV2 launch fees, the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split (Robinhood).
ProtocolRevenue.NFT Mint Fees to Protocol: 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds (Robinhood) — a first-party collection, so AGNT keeps all of it.
ProtocolRevenue.Activation Fees to Protocol: 100% of the AGNTS activation ETH fee (Robinhood).

HoldersRevenue.Activation $AGNTS Burned: The burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost (Robinhood).

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Fees to Doppler: 5% of launchpad pool fees paid to the Doppler protocol
SupplySideRevenue.Pons Fees to Engine: The ~5/7 (71.43%) of each PonsV2 launch fee forwarded from the AgntFeeWedge to the token's own engine (Robinhood).

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 3-level affiliate share (6% / 2.5% / 1.5%) credited to third-party referrers, from AffiliateCredited events.

SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate payouts: USDC credited to third-party referrers via AffiliateCredited events (3-level: 6% / 2.5% / 1.5%).

methodology.Fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers on Bitcoin-collateralised USDC loans.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrow interest distributed to USDC liquidity providers (LPs), from the lenderCut field of the InterestAccrued event.

methodology.Fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: the transfer tax is paid by token senders.
methodology.Revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury 10% of the Boardwalk share, plus governance epoch budgets that weekly votes direct to the treasury or into permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity (recognized when the epoch executes on Ethereum).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Tax shares accruing to launch issuers, stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP, referrers and integrators.

Fees.Token Tax: Transfer tax charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens.

UserFees.Token Tax: Transfer tax paid by token senders.

Revenue.Token Tax To Protocol: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps, 30bps when a referrer is set).

ProtocolRevenue.Token Tax To Treasury: 10% of the Boardwalk share, forwarded to the treasury (BoardwalkFeeCollector.GOVERNANCE_BPS).
ProtocolRevenue.Governance Epochs To Treasury: Weekly governance epoch budgets whose winning vote (or forced fallback) sends the WETH to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked BWLK Liquidity: Epoch budgets used to buy BWLK and mint permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity.

HoldersRevenue.BWLK Buyback Burns: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and burned to the dead address.
HoldersRevenue.Voter Distributions: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and streamed to the epoch's voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To LP Stakers: Share streamed to stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP via LPStaking fee epochs (default 15bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Referrers: Referrer's share, carved out of the Boardwalk share on Advanced launches (up to 5bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Integrators: Share split across the five integrator slots (10bps total).

methodology.Fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools (pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust).
methodology.Revenue: The USD share of swap fees, minus whatever Uniswap's protocol fee switch (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol) diverts to Uniswap itself.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token share of swap fees paid to the token creator, plus Uniswap's diverted cut of both swap fee legs (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol).

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Uniswap: Uniswap's protocol fee switch cut of both swap fee legs, read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol - no longer reaches Goon's protocol or the token creator.

methodology.Fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging, revenue is not calculated as exact costs can't be derived from the logs.

methodology.Fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's take: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade, plus unplaced creator fees swept to it.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.

Revenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

methodology.Volume: USDC wagered: both stakes of every market at the moment they lock into escrow (a market is only created on-chain once fully matched). This is betting volume, not deposits — funding a balance is not counted, only money committed to a bet. Each dollar is counted exactly once: the two stakes come from two different bettors, so this is the pot, not the maker/taker double count an orderbook has to halve. Cancelled markets refund the stakes, but the matched notional stays counted, in line with other prediction markets.

methodology.Fees: Sum of `fee` fields from `OptionExercised` (settlement fee on each exercised leg) and `PositionClosed` (matched-pair close fee). Both are charged at `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the exercised/closed collateral and paid in USDC.
methodology.Revenue: Equal to Fees (sum of `OptionExercised` and `PositionClosed` fees): the protocol has no governance token, and every fee is transferred to the on-chain `feeCollector_address` (which the owner can rotate via `setFeeCollector` / `FeeCollectorChanged`).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Equal to Fees (sum of `OptionExercised` and `PositionClosed` fees): the protocol has no governance token, and every fee is transferred to the on-chain `feeCollector_address` (which the owner can rotate via `setFeeCollector` / `FeeCollectorChanged`).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue
methodology.NotionalVolume: Sum of `amount` from each `optionIssued` event on StochasticOptions: USDC collateral committed by writers when minting a paired (long + short) position. Following the Prodigy/Dopex/Rysk convention of counting raw token amount (no oracle multiplication), this is the unit count of options minted — `1 USDC = 1 option unit` per protocol design.
methodology.PremiumVolume: Sum of USDC paid by option buyers on SFSwapV0Pair AMM pools, direction USDC→tradeToken only (the `amount0In` field of each `Swap` event). The reverse direction (tradeToken→USDC) is a writer unwinding their previously-sold leg and does not count as new premium inflow. Pair addresses are discovered from `PairCreated` events on the factory (one-time event per (token, tokenId) tuple).

Fees.Option Exercise Fee: Settlement fee on each leg exercised via `OptionExercised`. Computed as `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the collateral burned and transferred to `feeCollector_address`.
Fees.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fee on each leg unwound via `PositionClosed`. Same rate as the exercise fee (so this is not a cheaper substitute for `exercise`) and transferred to `feeCollector_address`.

Revenue.Option Exercise Fee: Exercise settlement fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.
Revenue.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.

ProtocolRevenue.Option Exercise Fee: Exercise settlement fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.
ProtocolRevenue.Option Close Fee: Matched-pair close fees routed to the on-chain `feeCollector_address`.

methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.
methodology.UserFees: The part paid by copyfomo users: service fee plus gas billed back. Excludes the $COPY creator fees, which are paid by $COPY traders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral rewards paid to copyfomo referrers, plus the actual on-chain cost copyfomo pays on users' behalf: the EVM bundler gas and the SOL spent by the Solana fee payer (transaction fees and token-account rent).
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Buyback & burn of $COPY, funded by the creator fees: what the copyfomo creator wallets pay (COIN or USDG) in every transaction where they buy $COPY from the pool and burn $COPY in the same transaction (the buyback account buys and burns in one user operation). Counted on the day of the buy, which follows the trades that generated the fees. A holder cashback leg (USDG distributed to $COPY holders) is planned and will be added when it goes live.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue minus HoldersRevenue: service revenue and the creator fees kept by copyfomo.

Fees.Treasury inflow: Every stablecoin transfer into the copyfomo treasury. The service fee and the gas billed back to the trader arrive together in one transfer and cannot be split on-chain.
Fees.$COPY creator fees: 2.7% of the COIN leg of every swap of the COPY/COIN Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain (PoolManager Swap events of the pool), valued at the hourly COIN price on Dune. Rate from the hook's launch config: 1% hook fee with 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax.

UserFees.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: everything copyfomo users pay.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: USDC sent by the copyfomo referral payout wallet on Base to referrers (its top-ups from the treasury are internal and excluded), plus any stablecoin sent by the treasury back to identified copyfomo user wallets.
SupplySideRevenue.Bundler gas cost: Gas the copyfomo bundler wallets paid to the ERC-4337 EntryPoint for users' operations, priced with the daily WETH / WBNB price.
SupplySideRevenue.Solana fee payer cost: SOL spent by the copyfomo Solana fee payer, which signs every copyfomo Solana transaction: signature fees and the rent of the token accounts it creates, net of rent returned on close (its balance change in its own transactions, excluding its top-ups co-signed by the Solana treasury), priced with the daily SOL price.

HoldersRevenue.Buyback & burn: COIN and USDG sent by the copyfomo creator wallets in every transaction that swaps on the COPY/COIN pool, delivers $COPY to them and burns $COPY from them (Transfer to the zero address) in that same transaction, since 2026-09-11 when the buyback programme started. The three manual buys of 2026-09-11, burned the next day in one transaction (hash in the query helper), are listed explicitly.

Revenue.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: gross service fees before the supply-side deductions.
Revenue.$COPY creator fees: Same as the Fees component: creator fees have no supply-side share.
Revenue.Referral rewards: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Bundler gas cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Solana fee payer cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Buyback & burn: Same as the HoldersRevenue component, subtracted from Revenue.

methodology.Fees: ETH fees on NFT AMM trades + NFT-backed loans; $STONKBROKER broker activation/upgrade fees; Stonk Interns mint fees (ETH leg, $STONKBROKER leg, $1 promotion fee) and intern activation fees; and the Relay swap-desk 1% app fee (Base USDC forwarded to StockBooster).
methodology.Revenue: 30% of NFTFi ETH fees, the full $STONKBROKER activation fee (burn + protocol), and the Stonk Interns protocol share (75% of the ETH mint leg, 100% of the STONK leg and promotion fee, the full intern activation fee).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 30% of NFTFi ETH fees → ProtocolFeeSink; protocol half of $STONKBROKER activation fees; Stonk Interns treasury legs and the protocol half of intern activation fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of the $STONKBROKER broker and intern activation/upgrade fees burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 70% of NFTFi ETH fees → StockBooster stock dividends; 25% of the Stonk Interns mint ETH leg → intern Clock In payroll; Relay swap-desk 1% app fees forwarded to StockBooster.

Fees.Stonk Interns mint fees (ETH leg + $STON: Stonk Interns mint fees: the $20 ETH leg of every paid release (DormantReleased.ethPaid), the $STONKBROKER mint leg (STONKBROKER transfers from the collection to the protocol treasury), and the flat $1 ETH promotion fee on every intern pay-share raise (InternShareSet.ethPaid).

Revenue.Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKB: Full $STONKBROKER intern activation fee (burned half + protocol half).

ProtocolRevenue.NFT AMM fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH AMM fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.
ProtocolRevenue.NFT loan fees → ProtocolFeeSink: 30% of ETH loan fees retained by ProtocolFeeSink.

ProtocolRevenue.Stonk Interns activation fees → protocol: Half of Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKBROKER → protocol treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Stonk Interns activation fees burned (50: Burned half of Stonk Interns activation fees in $STONKBROKER (deflationary).
