SupplySideRevenue.Swap-desk Relay app fees (1%): Relay swap-desk 1% app fee forwarded to StockBooster as a Clock In bonus top-up.

methodology.Fees: 1% (100 bps) app fee charged on swaps routed through Relay, collected in USDC. Reported per origin chain of the swap.
methodology.Revenue: All app fees accrue to the Based protocol; there is no supply-side or holder share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Identical to Revenue: the full app fee is kept by the protocol.

Fees.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

Revenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap app fees: 100 bps fee applied to swap volume routed through Relay.

methodology.Fees: The 0.25% integrator fee HyperDex charges on every swap, bridge and basket order routed through LI.FI: the FeesForwarded leg paid to HyperDex in a transaction whose LI.FI event carries integrator "hyperdex".
methodology.Revenue: All of the integrator fee goes to HyperDex.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the integrator fee goes to HyperDex.

Fees.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

Revenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator fee: The 0.25% integrator fee paid to HyperDex on each LI.FI-routed order.

methodology.Volume: Input amount of every swap routed through the vfat SwapRouter contracts, including swaps made by vfat Sickle smart wallets during zaps, rebalances and compounds. Excludes swaps sent by a vfat fee collector.
methodology.Fees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.
methodology.UserFees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.
methodology.Revenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Router fee taken from the output token of each swap.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To vfat: Router fees sent to the vfat.io fee collector.

methodology.Fees: 0.05% of the amount traded, collected by TRDEFI on positions created through its venue. The fee is embedded in the maker's signed order and paid to the receiver address when the position trades, so it is counted as the incoming token transfers it actually is. The fee rail has been in force since 2026-09-25; positions created before that carry no fee and are immutable.
methodology.Revenue: The entire collected trading fee. TRDEFI retains 100% of it, with no share paid to suppliers or holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The entire collected trading fee, retained by TRDEFI.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

Revenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 0.05% protocol fee charged on the amount traded when a position created through TRDEFI trades, retained by TRDEFI.

methodology.Fees: Native-token fees paid by users for completed Primus verification reports.
methodology.UserFees: Native-token fees paid by users for completed Primus verification reports.
methodology.Revenue: The portion of verification fees paid to Primus.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The portion of verification fees paid to Primus.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The portion of verification fees paid to attestor node operators.

Fees.Service Fees: Total fees settled when attestors successfully submit verification reports.

UserFees.Service Fees: Total fees paid by users for successfully completed verification reports.

Revenue.Service Fees To Primus: Verification fees allocated to Primus when reports are completed.

ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees To Primus: Verification fees allocated to Primus when reports are completed.

SupplySideRevenue.Service Fees To Attestors: Verification fees paid to attestor node operators when reports are completed.

methodology.Fees: Everything users pay: the fee charged on each swap of a launched token, the higher fee charged in the first minutes after a launch, the fee to create a launch, and the fee the Peddles Terminal and trade bot add to a swap.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of each swap fee and of the opening fee, plus all launch fees and all Terminal and trade bot fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of each swap fee and of the opening fee, plus all launch fees and all Terminal and trade bot fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of each swap fee paid to the token's creator and to the token's own holders, and the part of the opening fee returned to the pool as liquidity.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee charged on every swap of a launched token, in the asset the pool is paired against.
Fees.Opening Tax: The higher fee charged on swaps in the first minutes after a launch.
Fees.Launch Fees: The fee paid to create a launch, in the chain's native currency.
Fees.Terminal And Bot Fees: The fee the Peddles Terminal and trade bot add to a swap, in the chain's native currency.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of each swap fee.
Revenue.Opening Tax To Protocol: The protocol's share of the opening fee.
Revenue.Terminal And Bot Fees To Protocol: All Terminal and trade bot fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of each swap fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Opening Tax To Protocol: The protocol's share of the opening fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Terminal And Bot Fees To Protocol: All Terminal and trade bot fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Creators: The share of each swap fee paid to the token's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Token Holders: The share of each swap fee paid to holders of the launched token.
SupplySideRevenue.Opening Tax To Creators: The share of the opening fee paid to the token's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Opening Tax To Liquidity: The share of the opening fee returned to the pool as liquidity.

methodology.Fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on bridges.
methodology.Revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.

methodology.Fees: 1% of every trade on the bonding curve and in the graduated Uniswap v4 pools, plus the flat USDC fee paid to launch a coin.
methodology.Revenue: 30% of every trading fee and every launch fee, sent to the Lockcurve treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 30% of every trading fee and every launch fee, sent to the Lockcurve treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 70% of every trading fee, paid to the coin's creator.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: 1% of each buy and sell on a coin's bonding curve, read in USDC from the curve's Bought and Sold events.
Fees.Uniswap v4 Pool Swap Fees: 1% of each swap in a graduated coin's Uniswap v4 pool, taken by the Lockcurve hook and booked as 1% of the USDC side of the PoolManager's Swap event.
Fees.Launch Fees: The flat USDC fee a creator pays the treasury when launching a coin.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Treasury: 30% of bonding curve trading fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Pool Swap Fees To Treasury: 30% of pool swap fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees, sent in full to the treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Treasury: 30% of bonding curve trading fees, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Pool Swap Fees To Treasury: 30% of pool swap fees, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees To Treasury: Launch fees, sent in full to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: 70% of bonding curve trading fees, paid to the coin's creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Pool Swap Fees To Creators: 70% of pool swap fees, paid to the coin's creator.

methodology.Fees: Two things, and they are different money, and only the first of them is paid by anyone: it is reported as the user fee as well. First, the fee a trader paid on a swap in a pool the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set for that swap; the plugin takes no share of that fee, so nothing of it is charged to the user on the protocol's behalf. Second, the arbitrage the plugin realised inside the pool and paid out, read from the ProfitDistributed event where a deployment settles through a distributor and from the donatedToLps leg of ProfitShared where the plugin pays the pool's liquidity providers directly.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of the captured arbitrage, taken from the distributor's own share config as it stood at the block of each capture. Nothing of the swap fee is the protocol's, and the captures donated straight to liquidity providers leave it nothing either.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of the captured arbitrage, taken from the distributor's own share config as it stood at the block of each capture. Nothing of the swap fee is the protocol's, and the captures donated straight to liquidity providers leave it nothing either.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The swap fee in full, which the pool's liquidity providers and its AMM earn, plus the part of every capture that the share config pays to the pool's beneficiaries.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee traders paid on the pools the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set.
Fees.MEV Rewards: Arbitrage captured by the plugin when a swap moves the pool away from the wider market, closed out in the same transaction.

Revenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: The swap fee, which the pool's liquidity providers and its AMM earn in full.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To LPs: The rest of every capture, paid to the pool's beneficiaries.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees paid by GDEX users. Solana: received in SOL by the GDEX treasury, 1% of the SOL side of each swap and 0.1% on SOL withdrawals (1% when bridging). EVM chains: the 1% swap fee paid to the GDEX treasury by the KyberSwap router GDEX routes swaps through; EVM transfer and bridge fees are not included.
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers revenue

Fees.Trading Fees: 1% platform fee on GDEX swaps (Solana: plus 0.1% on SOL withdrawals, 1% when bridging), received by the GDEX treasury: in SOL on Solana, and on EVM chains as the KyberSwap router fee paid to the treasury, mostly in the native coin.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees - traders pay all of it; liquidity providers are not charged.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on a swap: the pool's swap fee from the Swap event (protocol fee included), plus what a Latch launch pool's guard takes itself - the creator tax, and on newer launch guards the guard's part of the trade fee - read from the guard's TaxTaken and FeeTaken events. Only Latch's own launch guards are read.
methodology.Revenue: What reaches the protocol, counted when the fee is taken: the protocol fee each Swap event carries; the protocol's share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under the pool's permanent LP lock split, only where the locks provably hold all of the pool's liquidity; and the protocol's share of the creator tax and guard trade fee under the split the guard stores for that pool. A split that cannot be read is never guessed: that amount is left out of Revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of Revenue. Latch has no token, so nothing is diverted to holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees minus Revenue: swap fees earned by liquidity providers, and the shares of locked-liquidity fees, creator tax and guard trade fees that go to launch creators and integrators (and any guard-taken amount whose split could not be read).
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap. Swaps in Latch's own test tokens (LTT1/LTT2 on Robinhood Chain) are excluded: they have no market and no price.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
Fees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
UserFees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
Revenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
Revenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Creators And In: Creator and integrator shares of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Creators And Integr: Creator and integrator shares of the guard-taken trade fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees, Split Not Read: Guard-taken trade fee whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators And Integrators: Creator and integrator shares of the creator tax.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax, Split Not Read: Creator tax whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.

methodology.Fees: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.
methodology.Revenue: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Aerodrome LP trading fees distributed to MAMO stakers via the multi-rewards contract.

Fees.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

methodology.Volume: Native coin paid on buys and received on sells on ADEXTO bonding curves, gross of fees. Trades by the ADEXTO team's own wallets are excluded.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.
methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator leg paid to each market's creator, the reserve leg that stays in the market's curve, and the buyback leg that buys and burns the market's own token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.

methodology.Fees: Actual quote-asset swap charges emitted by the verified TaxHook FeesAccrued event. V1 launches charge no trading tax. No token mint allocation, gas, deposits, claim payments or buyback execution is counted as a new fee.
methodology.Revenue: Treasury allocation of each fee on an accrual basis; excludes creators, referrers and launched-token buybacks.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same treasury allocation as Revenue. Fledgo has no own-token holder revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator recipients, attributed referrers and launched-token buyback allocations. Missing referrers retain their allocation for creators. Buybacks benefit the launched token, not a Fledgo governance token.

Fees.Trading fees: Exact totalFee in FeesAccrued, denominated in that registered pool configuration quote asset. Native ETH and native Arc USDC are 18-decimal raw amounts; ERC-20 quotes retain their own decimals. USD totals depend on DefiLlama historical price coverage.

Revenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to creator recipients: Per-swap gross quote times immutable creatorBps, minus buyback allocation and referral allocation only when the event names a nonzero referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to referrers: Per-swap gross quote times referralBps floored, only for an authenticated nonzero FeesAccrued referrer. Later claims are excluded.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to launched-token buybacks: Per-swap gross quote times buybackBps floored; later buybacks and burns settle this allocation and are not new fees or protocol-holder revenue.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Volume of completed cross-chain transfers routed through LilSwap, counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.UserFees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

Revenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees To Partners: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

methodology.Volume: Stablecoin amount of every completed P2P trade, read from the VailoxEscrow EscrowComplete events. Each trade is counted once (the off-chain fiat leg is not added) and cancelled or refunded trades are excluded.
methodology.Fees: Escrow fees paid by sellers and buyers on completed P2P trades, read from EscrowComplete events. Fees are tiered by trade size (fixed fee below 50 USD, then 1.25% down to 0.25%) with a lower rate for verified merchants. Cancelled or refunded trades pay no fee.
methodology.UserFees: All escrow fees are paid directly by the trading users.
methodology.Revenue: All escrow fees are kept by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All escrow fees go to the protocol treasury.

Fees.Seller Escrow Fees: Fee paid by the seller on top of the escrowed amount, charged when the trade completes.
Fees.Buyer Escrow Fees: Fee deducted from the amount the buyer receives when the trade completes.

UserFees.Seller Escrow Fees: Fee paid by the seller on top of the escrowed amount, charged when the trade completes.
UserFees.Buyer Escrow Fees: Fee deducted from the amount the buyer receives when the trade completes.

Revenue.Seller Escrow Fees To Protocol: Seller escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.
Revenue.Buyer Escrow Fees To Protocol: Buyer escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.

ProtocolRevenue.Seller Escrow Fees To Protocol: Seller escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.
ProtocolRevenue.Buyer Escrow Fees To Protocol: Buyer escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.

methodology.Fees: Everything PeddleQuest charges: the fee quest creators pay on top of the reward pool they deposit, the flat quest creation fee, the protocol's share of rewards that winners did not claim before the deadline, payments for trending and banner promotion slots, and the fee users pay to mint an optional completion badge.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: all of it is paid by quest creators, advertisers and badge minters. Joining a quest and claiming a reward are free.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) are kept by the protocol. Quest rewards themselves go to winners and are not counted as fees or revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) accrued to the protocol treasury (a Safe multisig).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of badge mint fees routed on-chain to buyback and burn. Zero while that route is switched off, which it has been since launch.

Fees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
Fees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Fees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Fees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Fees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

UserFees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
UserFees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
UserFees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
UserFees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
UserFees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

Revenue.Reward Pool Deposit Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
Revenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Revenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Revenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

ProtocolRevenue.Reward Pool Deposit Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
ProtocolRevenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
ProtocolRevenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
ProtocolRevenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
ProtocolRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

HoldersRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

methodology.Fees: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).
methodology.Revenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).

Fees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: 0.5% protocol fee charged on shielded pool deposits and withdrawals (ProtocolFeeCharged events on EVM; ProtocolFeeCharged and TokenFeeCharged events of the Solana program, kind 0 and 1). Relayer gas compensation is excluded.
Fees.Deposit Check Fees: Solana: fee charged for the AML check of a deposit that is refused or cancelled (ProtocolFeeCharged and TokenFeeCharged events, kind 2).
Fees.MASK Holder Rewards: ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from the StonkFun rewards distributor for holding MASK. Other ZEC transfers to the wallet are excluded.

Revenue.MASK Holder Rewards: All ZEC rewards received by the team wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.MASK Holder Rewards: All ZEC rewards received by the team wallet.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees, integrator app fees and swap costs paid by users on Relay bridges and swaps, excluding execution costs (network gas).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: App fees paid to the integrators that add them, and swap costs paid to liquidity providers. Excludes the integrator revenue share of the platform fee, which Relay does not disclose.
methodology.Revenue: Platform fees. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Platform fees kept by Relay. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.

Fees.Swap Costs: Payments to liquidity providers for cross-asset and cross-chain swaps. Excludes trades with unreliable token prices.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Costs To Liquidity Providers: Swap costs paid to the liquidity providers that fill cross-asset and cross-chain swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Platform Fee Revenue Share To Integrator: Relay pays qualifying integrators a revenue share of 0-67% of its platform fee, depending on the swap type and their 30-day volume. Relay does not report the amount, so it cannot be measured.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees charged by DeepCore pools, read from each Swap event (protocol fee included), plus the fee DeepCore's router charges on fills it routes to other venues, read from its Filled events. Launch-pool creator taxes and launch-guard trade fees are not counted.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees charged by DeepCore pools, read from each Swap event (protocol fee included), plus the fee DeepCore's router charges on fills it routes to other venues, read from its Filled events. Launch-pool creator taxes and launch-guard trade fees are not counted.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol fee slice each Swap event carried, plus the router fee on routed fills. Both are paid to the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol fee slice each Swap event carried, plus the router fee on routed fills. Both are paid to the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of each swap fee, earned by liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on DeepCore's CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap, read from Swap events. Trades the DeepCore router fills on other venues are not counted as volume.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Routing Fees: Fee charged by DeepCore's router on a fill routed to another venue (Filled.feeAmount).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Routing Fees: Fee charged by DeepCore's router on a fill routed to another venue (Filled.feeAmount).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Routing Fees To Protocol: Router fee on routed fills, paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Routing Fees To Protocol: Router fee on routed fills, paid to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.

methodology.Volume: USDC players spend opening Raflux gacha packs of physical trading cards (Super Gacha on Solana, FluxBox on Base), at the full pack price including any part covered by a coupon. Packs are sold at fixed prices of 10, 25, 50 and 100 USDC (1 USDC packs on Base at launch); each pack pulls a physical card, often with a USDC bonus, that the player can ship home or sell back for USDC.
methodology.Fees: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments. This is the 10% fee Raflux keeps when a card is exchanged for USDC plus the game result of pulls, so it is negative on days when players win more than they pay.
methodology.Revenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, kept by Raflux. No share goes to LPs, referrers or token holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, all of it sent to the Raflux treasury.

Fees.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, at the full pack price including any part covered by a coupon.
Fees.Buybacks: USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments.

Revenue.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, kept by Raflux before player payouts.
Revenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from revenue kept by Raflux.

ProtocolRevenue.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, sent to the Raflux treasury before player payouts.
ProtocolRevenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from treasury revenue.

SupplySideRevenue.Card Procurement, Grading & Vaulting: The platform buys the physical cards behind its packs and pays to grade, ship and vault them. These costs are paid offchain and not disclosed.

methodology.Fees: The 1% bonding curve trading fee on every Ferzan coin before it graduates (Meteora's DBC fee on Solana, including Meteora's protocol share).
methodology.UserFees: The 1% fee paid by traders on every Ferzan coin before it graduates.
methodology.Revenue: Ferzan's share of the curve fee: 50%, less 10% to a referrer when one is set. On Solana, half of the DBC trading fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Ferzan's share of the curve fee: 50%, less 10% to a referrer when one is set. On Solana, half of the DBC trading fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The coin creator's 50%, referrer payouts, and on Solana Meteora's protocol fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: None.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: 1% fee on every bonding curve buy and sell.
Fees.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Ferzan's Solana curves.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: 1% fee on every bonding curve buy and sell.
UserFees.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Ferzan's Solana curves.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Ferzan: Ferzan's share of the curve fee.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Ferzan: Ferzan's share of the curve fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Creators: Half of the curve fee, paid to the coin creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Referrers: 10% of the curve fee, paid to the referrer of the trade when there is one.
SupplySideRevenue.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Solana curves.

methodology.Volume: Service payments in USDC on Base settled through Central City's immutable fee routers with the fee included: the full price the router moves for each payment (90% to the seller, 10% fee to the treasury). Fee-on-top payments, where the router moves only the fee, are not counted. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.
methodology.Fees: The 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments, which AI agents make in USDC on Base for services on Central City's Feed (other payments carry no fee), charged by Central City's immutable fee routers and sent straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.
methodology.Revenue: The full 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments, which AI agents make in USDC on Base for services on Central City's Feed, kept by Central City: the immutable fee routers send it straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The full 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments, which AI agents make in USDC on Base for services on Central City's Feed, sent by Central City's immutable fee routers straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.

Fees.Service Fees: The 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments in USDC on Base, charged by Central City's immutable fee routers and sent straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.

Revenue.Service Fees To Treasury: The full 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments in USDC on Base, sent by Central City's immutable fee routers straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.

ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees To Treasury: The full 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments in USDC on Base, sent by Central City's immutable fee routers straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.

methodology.Volume: Gross USDC players pay to open card packs, including draws that are later refunded.
methodology.Fees: USDC players pay to open card packs, net of refunds and instant buybacks of won cards, plus marketplace fees on card trades.
methodology.Revenue: Pack sales net of refunds and buybacks, minus payouts to third-party card stakers, referral commissions and draw fees sent to the Jackpot, plus marketplace fees. Payouts for cards staked by the platform's own wallets stay in revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pack sales net of refunds and buybacks, minus payouts to third-party card stakers, referral commissions and draw fees sent to the Jackpot, plus marketplace fees, all kept by the TopMarket treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Card prices and profit shares paid or credited to third-party stakers whose cards were won, referral commissions settled to referrers, and draw fees routed to the Jackpot prize pool since October 2026.

Fees.Gacha Pack Sales: USDC paid for pack draws including the draw fee, minus refunded draws.
Fees.Card Buybacks: Instant buybacks paid to winners who sell their card back instead of keeping it; subtracted.
Fees.Marketplace Fees: Platform fee the Marketplace sends to its fee recipient on each card sale, accepted offer and settled auction.

SupplySideRevenue.Card Payouts To Stakers: Card price (keep) or profit share (recycle) paid or credited to third-party stakers at settlement; later withdrawals of existing credits and payouts to the platform Safe and treasury are excluded.
SupplySideRevenue.Jackpot Contributions: Draw fees routed to the Jackpot prize pool, which pays them back to players.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Commissions: Referral commissions TopMarket settles to referrers off-chain, taken from its public settlement feed when they settle.

Revenue.Gacha Pack Sales To Protocol: Pack sales net of refunds, minus payouts to third-party card stakers, pack referral commissions and Jackpot contributions.
Revenue.Card Buybacks: Instant buybacks paid to winners who sell their card back; subtracted.
Revenue.Marketplace Fees To Protocol: Marketplace fees received by the treasury, minus marketplace referral commissions.

ProtocolRevenue.Gacha Pack Sales To Protocol: Pack sales net of refunds, minus payouts to third-party card stakers, pack referral commissions and Jackpot contributions.
ProtocolRevenue.Card Buybacks: Instant buybacks paid to winners who sell their card back; subtracted.
ProtocolRevenue.Marketplace Fees To Protocol: Marketplace fees received by the treasury, minus marketplace referral commissions.

SupplySideRevenue.Card Procurement, Grading & Vaulting: The platform buys the physical cards behind its packs and pays to grade, ship and vault them. These costs are paid offchain and not disclosed.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the dynamic fee the Nami plugin sets for each swap.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the dynamic fee the Nami plugin sets for each swap.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees of gauged pools, paid to Nami token holders: 90% to veNAMI voters and 10% to ogNAMI stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap fees paid to Nami fee receivers other than Algebra, veNAMI voters and ogNAMI stakers.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees of gauged pools paid to veNAMI voters (90%) and ogNAMI stakers (10%).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees of permissionless pools: 99% to liquidity providers and 1% to Algebra as the DEX licence fee.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across all Nami V4 concentrated liquidity pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the per-swap fee emitted in the pool's SwapFee event.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the per-swap fee emitted in the pool's SwapFee event.

Revenue.Swap Fees To veNAMI Voters: 90% of gauged pools' swap fees, paid through the gauge to veNAMI voters.
Revenue.Swap Fees To ogNAMI Stakers: 10% of gauged pools' swap fees, converted and deposited into the ogNAMI staking contract.
Revenue.Swap Fees To Other Fee Receivers: Swap fees paid by a pool's fee vault to a receiver not identified as Algebra or ogNAMI stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Other Fee Receivers: Swap fees paid by a pool's fee vault to a receiver not identified as Algebra or ogNAMI stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To veNAMI Voters: 90% of gauged pools' swap fees, paid through the gauge to veNAMI voters.
HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To ogNAMI Stakers: 10% of gauged pools' swap fees, converted and deposited into the ogNAMI staking contract.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Swap fees of permissionless pools kept by liquidity providers (99%).
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Algebra: Algebra's licence fee, 1% of permissionless pools' swap fees.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by fee-earning liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume on Aero volatile and stable pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders.
Fees.External Bribes Rewards: Bribes (Aero calls them Liquidity Payments) paid to the protocol for a pool, counted as the protocol streams them out.

Revenue.Swap Fees To sAERO Holders: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, distributed to sAERO holders.
Revenue.External Bribes Revenue: Bribes paid to the protocol, distributed to sAERO holders allocating to the pool.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To sAERO Holders: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, distributed to sAERO holders.
HoldersRevenue.External Bribes Revenue: Bribes paid to the protocol, distributed to sAERO holders allocating to the pool.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Swap fees kept by fee-earning liquidity providers.

methodology.Fees: EVM chains: swap fees of the pools sasa creates for every coin, counted when sasa's builder collects them: the quote-asset side (ETH, BNB or USDC) and the coin side (in the launched coin, valued where the coin has a price). Solana: the creator fees of coins launched on sasa (both halves).
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the pool's swap fee (EVM) or the launch curve's creator fee (Solana) on every buy and sell.
methodology.Revenue: EVM: 70% of the collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault. Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: EVM: 70% of the collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault. Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: EVM: 30% of the collected swap fees, sent to each coin's creator, or used to buy back and burn the coin when its creator chose buybacks. Solana: the creators' 50% of the creator fees.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees of sasa-created Uniswap V4 / PancakeSwap Infinity pools, both sides, as collected by the builder (FeesCollected).
Fees.Creator Fees: Solana: creator fees of coins launched on sasa, shared 50/50 between sasa and the coin's creator.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees traders pay on every buy and sell in sasa-created pools.
UserFees.Creator Fees: Solana: the creator fee traders pay on every buy and sell of a coin launched on sasa.

Revenue.Swap Fees to sasa: 70% of collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault.
Revenue.Creator Fees to sasa: Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees to sasa: 70% of collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Fees to sasa: Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees to Creators and Buybacks: 30% of collected swap fees, sent to the coin's creator or used for its buy-and-burn.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees to Creators: Solana: the creators' 50% of the creator fees.

methodology.Volume: Gross quote-asset value of every buy and sell on CURB bonding curves (CurveBuy quoteIn; CurveSell quoteOut + fee + tax). Trading in graduated Uniswap v4 pools is excluded: it is counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.
methodology.Fees: The trading tax (1%-5%, set per launch) paid on every curve and graduated-pool trade, in the quote asset. The pools' 0.05% Uniswap v4 LP fee is not included: it is earned by the pool's liquidity and already counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the whole trading tax. Launching costs gas only.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of the tax (0.50% of the trade at deployment, frozen into each launch), plus the creator share of launches whose creator wallet is the treasury ($CURB).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the tax: to the launch's creator, or to the launch's own token holders through its distributor once holder sharing is on.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Tax: Platform share (fee) plus creator share (tax) of every CurveBuy and CurveSell on the bonding curve of a launch created by a CURB factory.
Fees.Graduated Pool Trading Tax: Every leg of the tax the FeeHook takes from a graduated pool swap, paid out (FeePaidDirect) or recorded as owed (FeeAccrued).

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Tax: Trading tax paid by bonding-curve traders.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Trading Tax: Trading tax paid by graduated-pool traders.

Revenue.Trading Tax To Treasury: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Tax To Treasury: The platform's share of the tax on both venues, plus the creator share of treasury-created launches ($CURB), paid to the treasury Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Creator share of the tax, paid to the launch's creator wallet.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Tax To Launch Holders: Creator share of the tax on launches with holder sharing on, paid to the launch's distributor and split among that launch's token holders.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid on vibe.market card coins: the ETH fee on every Base card coin trade, the WETH side of the Uniswap pool fees earned by graduated Base card coins, and the WETH fees collected by vibe.market's Robinhood Chain pack markets. Fees paid in $SPORTS or in card coins are not priced and are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of trading fees (on Base 40% of each trade's fee since August 2025, 20% before, plus the referrer shares of trades that name no referrer), and half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of trading fees, paid to the vibe.market Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Trading fees paid to pack creators and to referrers, and the creators' half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees.

Fees.Trading Fees: Fees charged on card coin and pack trades: the ETH fee on each Base card coin trade (7.5% since 2025-07-22, 5% before), and the WETH fees collected by the Robinhood Chain pack markets (pack trading fees and parent-pool fees).
Fees.LP Fees: WETH side of the 1% Uniswap v3 fees earned by the liquidity of graduated Base card coins.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of trading fees, including Base referrer shares that fall back to the protocol when a trade names no referrer.
Revenue.LP Fees To Protocol: Half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees, paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of trading fees, paid to the vibe.market Safe.
ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Protocol: Half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees, paid to the vibe.market Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: Share of trading fees paid to the creator of each pack.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Referrers: Share of Base trading fees paid to the referrer and origin referrer named on a trade.
SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees To Creators: Half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees, paid to the pack creator.

methodology.Fees: Gas fees paid by users
methodology.Revenue: Burned coins
